description: Compare up to three catalog agents for a task by name, grade and last successful check. Stateless and read-only; no conversation is saved. Searches A2A first, then MCP; x402 requires an explicit choice. price_status is free, paid or paid_or_unknown (price_usdc null). Returns the same ranked list as find_agents; use find_agents when you are ready to connect. Use when you want to browse and compare candidates for one task before choosing. Example arguments: {"task": "translate a document to Spanish"} Ads: at most one offer labelled "Sponsored" may follow the results in a separate `sponsored` field; it never changes the results.

auth.description: Compatibility field; authentication preference does not affect ranking.

category.description: Compatibility field; task relevance is derived from the task text.

k.description: Compatibility field; at most three results is returned.

kind.description: Explicit recommendation protocol filter; Any searches A2A then MCP, excluding x402. Defaults to A2A first, then MCP; x402 requires an explicit choice.

task.description: The specific capability needed (e.g. 'weather forecast', 'stock price', 'web search')

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: search

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

sponsored.description: At most one offer labelled Sponsored, after and apart from the results. Each item carries `sponsored: true` and a `disclosure` object: advertising does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

title: Browse agents for a task
